exposure.needed: which dashboards, alert rules, or scrape pipelines in the environment consume cilium_ces_sync_errors_total

consequence.statement: cilium_ces_sync_errors_total disappears from Cilium's exported metrics in 1.16; anything scraping, charting, or alerting on it simply stops receiving data for it, though Cilium itself keeps running.
consequence.remediation: Remove or update dashboards and alert rules that reference cilium_ces_sync_errors_total.

assertion.statement: Cilium 1.16 removes the cilium_ces_sync_errors_total metric, listed under "Removed Metrics" in the 1.16 upgrade notes, so it is no longer exported.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: the change names a Prometheus metric (cilium_ces_sync_errors_total), which no supported subject family can identify
